## What's changed

skiagram 0.1.2 refreshes cost estimates for the July 2026 model lineup while preserving the
project's offline-first and never-guess accounting rules.

- Adds official standard API pricing for GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna; GPT-5.5/5.4 families;
  GPT-5.3 Codex; Claude Fable, Opus, Sonnet, and Mythos 5; and Gemini 3.6 Flash,
  3.5 Flash/Flash-Lite, and 3.1 Pro Preview.
- Applies published long-context tiers for eligible OpenAI and Gemini models.
- Reads Codex cache-write tokens and prices them separately from uncached input and cache reads.
- Stops inventing cache-price multipliers when a provider does not publish a compatible rate.
- Documents exact rates, official sources, pricing scope, and the time-limited Claude Sonnet 5
  introductory rate in [`docs/pricing.md`](https://github.com/TanvirAnjumApurbo/skiagram/blob/v0.1.2/docs/pricing.md).

Package-manager builds remain offline and use the embedded 2026-07-31 snapshot. See the
[changelog](https://github.com/TanvirAnjumApurbo/skiagram/blob/v0.1.2/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

## Windows package managers

```powershell
winget upgrade --exact --id TanvirAnjumApurbo.skiagram
scoop update skiagram
```

The WinGet manifest is submitted after release assets are published and may appear later while the
`microsoft/winget-pkgs` PR is reviewed.
